purpose: Cover US-206 (wespa's embedding contract is proved by a CI host fixture): the fixture renders a 56px header + resizable sidebar around an iframe pointed at ./?embed=1&theme=light with no inline script (AC-206-1), theme flips via postMessage without a reload (AC-206-2, source invariants + Playwright live proof in the lane evidence), embed and theme survive a hash-only in-iframe navigation (AC-206-3, source invariants + Playwright live proof), cross-origin messages are ignored by the viewer listener (AC-206-4), the three lints keep framing headers, target=_top and localStorage namespace in place (AC-206-5), and no new outbound postMessage shape is introduced by the viewer or the fixture (AC-206-6). All TCs resolve to node tests under test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js.
title: Wespa host fixture: iframe shell, theme postMessage, hash-nav embed preservation, cross-origin refusal, three lints, no new outbound postMessage shape

testCases.description: renderTestHostPage returns an HTML5 document with a 56px wespa-header, data-rcf-host-sidebar + data-rcf-host-sidebar-drag markers, data-rcf-host-theme light/dark toggles, an iframe whose src is literally './?embed=1&theme=light' (HTML-entity encoded), a '<script src=./test-host.js defer>' line and zero inline <script> blocks.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::renderTestHostPage: HTML5 document, no inline script, iframe src is ./?embed=1&theme=light

testCases.description: The router serves /test-host.html with the fixture body (iframe src + script tag) and /test-host.js with application/javascript when testHost: true; both routes return 404 by default so wespa's reverse-proxy allow-list is unaffected.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::/test-host.html is served when testHost: true; iframe src and no inline script round-trip over HTTP

testCases.description: src/view/test-host/embed-client.js posts { type: 'rcf-view-theme', theme } to iframe.contentWindow targeting window.location.origin, and its code (comments stripped) contains no localStorage/sessionStorage write (ADR-4136 does-not-persist invariant). The live postMessage round-trip is captured in Playwright evidence (agents/dave/remote-lane/inbox/r-20261002-161325-e2a2/output/evidence/test-host-dark-iframe-flipped.png).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::AC-206-2: embed-client posts { type: rcf-view-theme, theme } to the iframe targeting window.location.origin

testCases.description: src/view/page-init.js exposes writeHash (reassigns location.hash only, preserving the search string by construction) and stamps data-embed + data-theme on load. Live hash-nav proof lives in Playwright evidence (hash-nav-proof.txt + test-host-iframe-hash-nav-embed-preserved.png).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::AC-206-3: page-init preserves embed=1 and theme= across hash writes (urlWithHash + writeHash)

testCases.description: src/view/page-init.js registers an addEventListener('message', ...) whose first guard returns early when ev.origin !== window.location.origin; cross-origin messages never reach the applyTheme path and <html data-theme> is unchanged.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::AC-206-4: page-init theme message listener rejects messages whose origin differs from window.location.origin

testCases.description: assertFramingHeaders over GET / returns ok: true (no X-Frame-Options; no CSP frame-ancestors forbidding same-origin). Positive + negative unit cases also pass (refuses on X-Frame-Options present, refuses on frame-ancestors 'none', accepts frame-ancestors 'self').
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::lint 1 (framing): GET / carries no X-Frame-Options and no CSP frame-ancestors that forbids same-origin

testCases.description: assertNoTargetTop returns count: 0 across every rendered page (renderPage shell, renderComponentsFixturePage, renderTestHostPage). Positive + negative unit cases cover target="_top" / target='_top' / target=_top.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::lint 2 (target="_top"): zero occurrences across every rendered page (shell, components fixture, test-host fixture)

testCases.description: assertLocalStorageNamespace over the src/view tree returns ok: true; every localStorage/sessionStorage call site resolves to a key starting with 'rcf-view:v1:'.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::lint 3 (localStorage namespace): every storage call site under src/view uses an rcf-view:v1: key

testCases.description: A grep over src/view/** (excluding test-host/embed-client.js, the sanctioned emitter) finds zero .postMessage( call sites; the embed-client itself posts exactly one shape, 'rcf-view-theme'.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js::AC-206-6: no outbound postMessage shape beyond rcf-view-theme is introduced by the viewer or the fixture
